task: Implement bounded product HTML extraction and all rubric subchecks with evidence, conservative abstention and complete real-product report verification.
nonGoals: Frontend, shared dependencies, workflow weakening, paid services, unrelated Cloudflare resources, merge or deployment

outcomes.description: Extract scoped ordinary HTML product facts, policies and schema with explicit bounded coverage and provenance; never repair malformed JSON into fabricated evidence.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen happy, malformed, hidden, variant, truncation and injection fixtures.

outcomes.description: Implement all 40 subchecks, category attributes and questions, exclusions, evidence-backed deductions, grouped fixes and conditional point recovery. Missing inspection remains incomplete.
outcomes.evidence: Full report, partial report, contradictory and missing data regressions and score invariants.

outcomes.description: Verify supported real product pages offline and document practical category, language, rendering and retrieval limitations honestly.
outcomes.evidence: Captured public-page replay results and independent review.

process.description: Separate committed plan, Terra implementation and independent review, actual source-bound evaluation and hosted CI; no merge or deployment.
process.evidence: Git history, evaluation trace, review and PR.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse bounded fetch and inspection logic without dependencies.

exitTest.reason: Backend extraction and scoring change does not alter portability, workflow, memory or continuation semantics; handoff records replay steps.
